# Handout Remake

Turn lecture slides, PDFs or notes into a dark-mode study handout re-taught from scratch for the 11-inch iPad: life context first, plain-language definitions with Chinese-English term pairs, diagrams, formulas, worked examples and practice pages with dotted writing areas and answers on the next page, built into a fully vector PDF. Output language: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).
